name: abox k8s-agent: HelmReleases that are not Ready
description: IN_ORDER: the listing call must happen; a follow-up describe is allowed, not required.

parts.text: Is any HelmRelease in the cluster not Ready? Name it and say why.
Four are not Ready: triage-agent, triage-core and triage-ui (private GHCR packages, missing ghcr-credentials) and xray-memory (its pod cannot mount the missing Secret xray-memory-auth).
